title: Profile Info block
description: Agent or person profile — name, pronouns, designation, company, bio and photos

displayStyle.description: Visual layout of the profile block. Renamed from 'layout' (.ai/block-card-appearance-plan.md, qcg-frontend-next) to free the layout.* namespace for the shared appearance/transparent/fullWidth system below. 'stacked'/'overlay'/'overlay-wave' are 1:1 ports of classic business-card templates 4/6/7 (qcg-frontend-next profile-info/renderer.tsx). 'quick-contact' reads a sibling contact_details block's data at render time via LandingContext (qcg-frontend-next shell/context.ts) — it stores no phone/email/address of its own.

portraitHeight.description: Profile photo height preset for the 'portrait' displayStyle only; ignored by every other layout (frontend: packages/blocks/src/blocks/landing/profile-info/definition.ts).

name.description: Full name — written by the vCard Angular form and used when the block is authored under the vCard/dynamicVCard categories.

first_name.description: First name — written directly by the live business-card Angular form (no 'name' field exists there at all).

last_name.description: Last name — written directly by the live business-card Angular form.

textStyle.description: Classic business-card ports only (stacked/overlay/overlay-wave): the card's own text colour and name size carried over from classic design_info (textColor = primaryText; fontSize = fontSize.name in rem on classic's 14px root). Other displayStyles ignore it.

photoStyle.description: Overrides for the floating profile photo used by the float/float-bg/hero displayStyles.

ringColor.description: Photo ring/border colour, independent of cardStyle.backgroundColor. Empty string or omitted falls back to cardStyle.backgroundColor, then the theme surface colour.

backgroundStyle.description: Accent/hero-zone or card-surface background (frontend: packages/blocks/src/blocks/landing/profile-info/definition.ts) — distinct from cardStyle.backgroundColor, which only affects the description text strip.
